title: Post History Walkthrough
subtitle: Turn past posts into a working knowledge base

scenes.caption: Open Post History with safe demo data.
scenes.narration: Post History is the memory of the account. It shows what has already been posted, helps avoid repeats, and gives the system better context.

scenes.caption: Show how history guides the next post.
scenes.narration: The value is context. You can review the pattern, then decide what to say next without repeating the same angle.
